title: Sign Service State
description: Computes an HMAC signature of any pipeline value using the Web Crypto API. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/sign)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

secret.description: Shared secret used as the HMAC key

finalize.description: **Progressive mode only** — computes and emits the HMAC over all buffered chunks
